messages:
Ava B.: Hi all — new hire here. Laptop arrived but tracker says dock + monitor were 'Left at Front Desk' earlier; nothing at my desk (3F-22). Also can't authenticate to 'Redwood-Staff' Wi-Fi: 802.1X authentication failed. I filed ticket #6342 but tagging IT.

IT Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #6342 logged and assigned to Ravi (IT). Expected response in ~20-30 mins.

Ravi (IT): Welcome Ava! Can you paste the carrier tracking number? Meanwhile try joining 'Redwood-Guest' and check the onboarding email for a temporary token. What OS are you on?

Ava B.: Tracking YT987654321US — shows "Delivered to Front Desk" at 09:05. I'm on macOS 14.2. I don't see any guest token in the onboarding email.

Felix - Mailroom: Hi @Ava B. 12; YT987654321US is on Mailroom A shelf labeled 'New Hires'. I can deliver to 3F in ~15 mins or you can pick up. :package:

Ravi (IT): DMing a guest token now. If the 802.1X prompt keeps failing on mac, go to System Settings -> Profiles and remove any stale 'Redwood' or 'Corp WiFi' profile, then reboot Wi-Fi and try the guest token.

Ava B.: Got the token via DM. Removed an old profile and now the Staff Wi-Fi auth worked — connected! :tada: Felix just delivered the monitor and dock too.

Ravi (IT): Awesome. For the dock, plug it in first to power, then connect the laptop. If external display doesn't appear, open Displays settings and try "Detect Displays" while holding Option, or toggle the monitor input. Ping me if power doesn't pass through.

Ava B.: Everything's up and running. Huge thanks for the rapid help! :)
